x402.bareProbe: A bare GET (no query) or zero-byte POST with no payment header on any paid URL returns HTTP 402 at once: the v1 JSON body (x402Version 1, network base, maxAmountRequired) plus the v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402Version 2, network eip155:8453, amount, extensions.bazaar with a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 schema).

settlement.note: A settled call returns 200 with both PAYMENT-RESPONSE and X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE (base64 {success, transaction, network, payer}). That receipt is the facilitator's settlement assertion bound to the payer; the MCP client checks it against the signed authorization but does not look the transaction up on Base (onchainReceiptVerified: false).

settlementGuard.replay: best-effort replay rejection: synchronous same-isolate in-flight + FIFO (4,096) sets block same-isolate concurrent/serial replays, and non-atomic eventually-consistent KV used_tx:<txHash> (30-day TTL) blocks post-propagation serial cross-isolate replays (402 replay_settlement_tx); concurrent cross-isolate races before KV write/propagation are not globally atomic without Durable Objects
settlementGuard.requires: receipt status 0x1 and canonical USDC (Base) Transfer(payer -> payTo) logs summing to at least the route price

x402.settlementGuardNote: In x402_paid mode the gateway verifies every settlement on Base before releasing the product: eth_getTransactionReceipt must show status 0x1 and canonical USDC Transfer(payer -> payTo 0xcA4E2ff22B69A7284210c47BdeE21Aac1269da09) logs summing to at least the route price, and replays are rejected on a best-effort basis (402 replay_settlement_tx) via synchronous same-isolate state and non-atomic eventually-consistent KV used_tx:<txHash>; concurrent cross-isolate races are not globally atomic without Durable Objects. Otherwise the product is withheld: 402 unconfirmed_or_reverted_settlement_tx / insufficient_onchain_usdc_transfer, or 502 settlement_rpc_unavailable when no Base RPC answers.
